ai_summary: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited announced a significant leadership transition, with Mr. Deo Shankar Tripathi moving from his Executive Vice Chairman and Key Managerial Personnel role due to early retirement to immediately becoming the Interim Non-Executive Chairperson. This ensures the company retains his five decades of invaluable industry experience and strategic oversight despite his departure from an executive capacity. While the "early retirement for personal reasons" and "interim" designation suggest a planned but possibly evolving leadership structure, this move mitigates concerns of an abrupt leadership vacuum.
